statue.scale_note: Body and pedestal contact positions calibrated in exported images; logical 2x2 footprint unchanged. Pedestal drawing height=32 after calibration.
statue.dormant: base at original center; body foot at matching pedestal mountAnchors[direction], 32 drawing units above ground
statue.awake: same body strip at moving 2x2 unit center x+0.5,y+0.5; no base attached
statue.awakening_transition: body lowers from base mount height to ground through event transform; do not change image scale or snap contact anchor
statue.base_after_awakening: Recommended visual-only remnant at original location; no new blocking, elevation, targeting or terrain effect. Separate visibility flag required.
statue.reuse_limit: Current translate-and-turn movement can reuse idle art. This does not supply full combat animation.

gate.mapping: front wall, posts, upper gable, timber, opening/frame as separate geometry; F01 back/sides and F03 broken ends; two-sided front PNG alone insufficient
gate.passage_rule: keep six logical exit cells unchanged; no tall rubble or columns in passage

geometry_recipes.rubble: P01 top clusters + low irregular geometry; F03 sides; decorative-only clusters may remain flat; collision independent
geometry_recipes.gravestone: P02 front/back/side/top on one thin rounded-head solid; P02_top is rectangular corrected image; broken uses F03 fracture; no baked ground
geometry_recipes.fence: P03 straight/broken on paired front/back planes with F05 edge thickness, P03_post on narrow upright geometry; fallen on actual low plane; poles separated for depth
geometry_recipes.chapel_door: P04 leaves front/back on hinge-controlled thin solids; F04 thickness; P04_frame on stone geometry, P04_tracery in upper opening; F01/F03 sides; master is reference only
geometry_recipes.spikes: P06_triangle is side face, not complete sprite; extrude wedge or triangular spike, F05 other faces; compose a patch above floor; logical thorn cells unchanged
geometry_recipes.stairs: G01/G02 treads + F01/F03 risers; actual elevation difference 40 per level; initially four risers of 10 for one level; orient by high/low neighboring cells, not camera
geometry_recipes.bridge: G07 top + F04 beams/supports; material UV rotates with whole bridge; preserve logical road assignment
geometry_recipes.pit: continuous outer boundary + appropriate F02/F03 exposed sides + game shadow/void; no new texture required; adjoining pits form one opening
